summary: Regression check after the serverless refactor (lazy Motor proxy, ensure_ready dependency, api/index.py entrypoint). Backend: 43/43 pytest passed against the public URL. This covers health, usage, generate on all 7 platforms with real Groq calls, hooks/regenerate, refine-tone, drafts CRUD and client isolation, library filters and pagination, newsletter, refund on provider failure, and the 429 limit with the unique-index-based reserve. Fresh-DB auto-setup: ran uvicorn api.index:app on port 8099 with DB_NAME=hooklink_fresh. The first /api/library returned 200 with total 30 and 8 items. All indexes were created: usage {ip,date} unique, subscribers email unique, drafts {client_id, created_at}, library_hooks number. BUG FOUND: when many requests hit a cold process at the same time, the library seed is duplicated. In 3 cold-start runs with 20 concurrent requests, the DB ended up with 90, 60 and 120 library_hooks. Responses reported total 0, 20, 40 ... 200. With only 5 concurrent requests it stayed at 30. UI smoke on the preview URL: workspace shows 5 of 5 and the 7 seeded drafts. The library shows 'Viewing 8 of 30 ideas' and Load More goes to 16 of 30. Clicking a draft opens refinement.html?draft=... with the LinkedIn preview and analysis. All API calls go to the same origin /api and return 200. 0 console errors.

critical.endpoint: core/setup.py ensure_ready + seed.py seed_library (any first /api request on a cold instance)
critical.issue: Race on cold start. Concurrent first requests all see _ready=False. Each runs count -> delete_many -> insert_many at the same time, so 30 hooks become 60-120 docs. /api/library then returns wrong totals and duplicate cards until a later cold start re-seeds. On Vercel, separate instances can also cold-start in parallel, so an in-process lock alone is not enough.

minor.issue: When the event loop changes, a new AsyncIOMotorClient is created and the old one is never closed. This can leak connections on serverless runtimes that use a new loop per invocation. Close the previous client before replacing it.

action_items: Make seed_library idempotent and safe under concurrency on every instance. Create a unique index on library_hooks.number. Seed with bulk_write UpdateOne({'number': i}, {'$set': doc}, upsert=True) instead of delete_many + insert_many, and remove extra docs with delete_many({'number': {'$gt': len(HOOKS)}}). Also guard ensure_ready with an asyncio.Lock so concurrent requests in one process await a single setup.
Optional: in core/db.py, close the previous Motor client when the loop changes.
critical_code_review_comments: setup.py: _ready is set only after seeding succeeds. That is good, because a failure retries on the next request. But there is no lock, so N concurrent cold requests run setup N times (see the critical issue above).
library_hooks 'number' index is not unique, so nothing at the DB level prevents duplicates.
Tests need REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported in the shell (it is read from the environment, not from frontend/.env). Export it before running pytest.
Carried over: refinement.js does not await navigator.clipboard.writeText (low priority).

success_rate.backend: 43/43 pytest passed (100%); fresh-DB setup works for sequential requests but fails the concurrent cold-start check

seed_data_creation: Used seed_ui_drafts.js (TEST_ui) and then deleted those drafts. db.usage reset. hooklink_fresh dropped and the port 8099 server killed. hooklink.library_hooks = 30.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env value>. To reproduce the race: drop hooklink_fresh, start uvicorn api.index:app --port 8099 with DB_NAME=hooklink_fresh, send 20 concurrent curl requests to /api/library?limit=50, then count library_hooks (expected 30). Repeat 3 times. Drop hooklink_fresh afterwards.
